concerns.note: This change resolved no living-spec capability, so nothing was loaded before it and nothing was folded after it. Either the areas it touched belong to no capability yet, or a capability claims them and no requirement describes them — `living-validate` names which.
NodeView moved from freemind/ui to core because the format-agnostic test kit returns it; plan tree reconciled in T121
EditingInstaller relies on FileEditorManagerListener.fileOpened firing under the headless test fixture; T102 proves it first
R12 Rider fallback would change Phase 1 files (plugin.xml, build.gradle.kts); T071 stops for replanning if needed

BLOCKER: in Rider, WebStorm and PyCharm 2026.2, $Undo from the designer canvas does nothing after Add Child Node. UndoManager.isUndoAvailable(composite) is true, but UndoManager.undo(composite) asks 'Undo last operation?', so the platform treats the designer's command as global instead of editor-local. IntelliJ IDEA passes. EditUndoIntegrationTest fails in the three products; T089, T104 and the T112 removal gate stay open.
T072-T103 were built in an earlier session and closed together in this one after the suite passed, so their finish timestamps are this session's close times, not when the work was done.

core AdpEditorProviderTest.stateKeepsZoomAndSelection sometimes fails in teardown: Windows reports its temp directory in use by another process. It happens with and without this session's changes and passed on rerun.
Local History recording (FR-005) is not verified automatically: the light test IDE records no revisions, so the test skips. It needs the manual pass (T123).

The earlier BLOCKER (Undo does nothing in Rider, WebStorm and PyCharm) no longer reproduces: EditUndoIntegrationTest passed in all four IDEs on three consecutive runs. The Rider failure logged at 23:31 on 2026-09-24 most likely ran against a plug-in zip built before the selection moved into the command; this cannot be proven after the fact.

verified[] holds four exit-1 entries whose result is "not recognized as an internal or external command": --verify-run runs through cmd.exe outside the repository root, so ./gradlew and a bare gradlew.bat fail. They are tooling failures, not test failures; the passing receipts use the absolute gradlew.bat path with -p.

T113/T114 (git rm of the previous build and spec 001 host artifacts) were denied by the auto-mode permission classifier; T115, T117-T119 and Polish are paused behind them for the maintainer to authorise

T115 (stripping old-host content from specs/001-freemind-mindmap-designer/.spec-context.json) was refused by the auto-mode classifier twice; it is the only tracked file still naming the previous host, so T119 and NoPreviousHostIntegrationTest stay red until it is done

T123 to T125 are manual (install in IDEA/Rider/WebStorm/PyCharm, SC-006 walkthrough with a new developer, FreeMind 1.0.1 hand check, repo rename). An agent cannot do them, so the spec stays at implementing.

anchor.heading: Feature Specification: JetBrains IDE Support
anchor.blockText:
**Feature Branch**: `002-jetbrains-ide-support`
**Created**: 2026-09-24
**Status**: Draft
**Input**: "Enhance the codebase so that it also runs in IntelliJ, JetBrains Rider and other related IDE's."

reviewComments.comment:
Take notice that this specification is not intended to be an additional plug-in. The work should be to replace the eclipse plug-in completely with a intellij plug-in. 

There should be no traces of eclipse left.

decisions.decision: AdpDesignerEditor.model() runs a queued re-parse on the EDT before returning
decisions.why: an action reading the model right after a document change got the previous parse and could build an edit on stale offsets; it also made ExternalChangeTest order-dependent
decisions.rejected: a longer settle() loop in the test driver, which hides the stale read instead of fixing it

decisions.decision: Local History test compares against a plain text file saved the same way, and skips when that control has no revision
decisions.why: the light test IDE keeps no Local History revisions for these files, so the old assertion could never pass
getChildren(null) logs a SEVERE error in every 2026.2 IDE

decisions.decision: Kept execute() running the selection inside the WriteCommandAction and did not change the composite undo state
decisions.why: with that change EditUndoIntegrationTest passes in all four IDEs, twice in a row; a temporary state log showed the command and undo states match
decisions.rejected: stripping the hidden text editor state from the composite UNDO state, which fixed nothing that still failed
